title: A read-only Codex reviewer child has the tracker's MCP server and no host gate, so it can write to the tracker
outcome: A read-only Codex delegation child that is not an evaluator can make the tracker's reads that record nothing (the same list the Claude gate uses) and cannot make a tracker call that writes: by a read-only surface the host provides, or by a gate on Codex's tool calls, chosen and recorded with its reason.
acceptance: A read-only Codex reviewer child's tracker reads from the list succeed and every tracker word that writes is refused or absent; a test shows both.
The choice between a host-provided read-only surface and a gate on Codex's tool calls is recorded on the item with its reason, including what Codex's approval policy `never` makes possible.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
